Board of Assessors

413-886-5256 
 
 
I. Call to Order 
10:00 AM Meeting called to order on November 4, 2026 at City Hall – Room 205, 36 Court Street, Springfield, MA. 
 
 
II. Public Portion 
 
 
A. Meeting Minutes 
• Public Meeting Minutes 10/7/2026; 10/14/2026; 10/21/2026 & 10/29/2026 
 
 
III. Executive Session 
The Board will vote to enter into Executive Session for the following reasons: 
 
1. ATB Docket Review 
  
Pursuant to M.G.L.ch 30A, section 21(3) the Board will enter into executive session to discuss the litigation strategy of matters currently 
scheduled at the Appellate Tax Board.  Discussion of these matters in an open public session will have a detrimental effect on the Board’s 
litigation strategy.  
 
 
2. FY 2027 Personal Exemptions 
Pursuant to M.G.L.ch 30A, section 21(7) and M.G.L.ch 59, section 60 and M.G.L.c. 59, section 5, the Board will enter into executive 
session to discuss personal exemptions.
